messages:
olivia-logistics: Heads-up: H100 shipment AWB 987-6543210 is stuck at FRA last-mile. Carrier reporting EDI feed timeouts causing manifest validation failures. Need quick decision: hold for depot inspection or split 10 units to air.
vendor-forwarder: Apologies. Broker queue at FRA caused EDI timeouts; manifest rejected on our side. ETA slip ~18-24h while we clear broker backlog. Tracking still shows hub hold.
olivia-logistics: Any customs paperwork missing? last incident stalled on HS codes.
vendor-forwarder: HS codes ok, but local authority flagged a thermal check on a random 8-unit sample. They want depot photos + serial audit before release.
chris-procurement: If depot delays exceed 24h we should consider air-splitting 10 H100s to meet commitments. Cost ballpark?
vendor-forwarder: Quick estimate: +€95k for next-day air for 10 units FRA→LHR including uplift/brokerage. Can split AWBs if we approve today.
anna-ops: Are those 10 earmarked for any active Dedicated pools? Jamal, any infra impact if they're delayed 48h?
jamal-sre: Yes — those 10 back two EU burst pools. A 48h delay will increase inference queue latency ~30–40% at peak. We have smaller-model fallbacks but SLAs may slip.
olivia-logistics: Also need vendor confirmation that RMA handling remains contiguous for split AWBs — we don't want two separate RMAs for the same failing unit.
vendor-forwarder: Warranty follows serial. We'll attach the same RMA reference to any split AWB. Depot photos + signed manifest trigger RMA flow.
rma-bot: RMA created: RMA-8472 linked to AWB 987-6543210. Status: awaiting depot photos.
olivia-logistics: Uploading photo archive and serial list now. Example serials uploaded:
serials: [H100-AB1234, H100-AB1235, H100-AB1236, H100-AB1237, H100-AB1238, H100-AB1239, H100-AB1240, H100-AB1241, H100-AB1242, H100-AB1243]
anna-ops: If we go air-split, vendor must provide signed statement that warranty/insurance chain is preserved. Put that into the RMA notes.
vendor-forwarder: We'll add legal attestation to RMA-8472 and ensure the same claim flow. No duplicate RMAs per serial.
chris-procurement: I'll submit the €95k uplift for finance approval. If finance rejects, we'll accept a 24h hold and trigger Jamal's canary scaling.
jamal-sre: Canary scaling plan ready. I'll pre-warm smaller instance types and adjust autoscale thresholds. If hold >36h, push for air-split.
olivia-logistics: Vendor — if the EDI outage is root-cause on your network, can you commit to a surcharge waiver or credit for expedited uplift?
vendor-forwarder: Escalated to ops — partner EDI had an outage. They're opening a surcharge dispute and will request waiver. Can't promise, will update in ~2–3h.
anna-ops: Added legal note in RMA requiring depot photo acceptance language for insurance.
olivia-logistics: Okay holding for vendor confirmation on waiver. If denied, we move to air-split by 18:00 CET. Please prioritize photos + signed manifest. :thumbsup:
vendor-forwarder: Understood. Prioritizing depot photos and manifest sign-off. Will update by 17:30 CET or earlier.
chris-procurement: If waiver confirmed, procurement greenlights air-split. Finance sign-off required otherwise.
olivia-logistics: Thanks everyone — keeping thread open. Uploading courier and photo audit links for records.
